clips.text: Earl, it's Dolores out on the Hondo road. The lights are back over the mesa. Same as last fall.
Anybody else lose the TV a little after two? Just a hum, most of a minute. Then it came back.
My dog won't come out from under the trailer. He's been under there since one.
Hello? Is this the radio? There's a star with a tail on it, real low in the south. A little tail.
I'm calling from my dad's place, out on the ranch. There's a light over the mesa too. It isn't moving.
He's out with the men. It's hot out. It's July.
Earl? I can't sleep. The wind stopped all at once tonight, like somebody shut a door.
I drove past the motor court a while ago. There's somebody sitting up on the roof. Small. Real still.
Earl, you know the old survey station, out the gravel west of the highway?
Somebody put a new chain on it. Shiny. Who buys a new chain for a place nobody goes?
Earl, somebody's been cutting my fence on the Hondo road. Both ends, clean, like with bolt cutters.
Wind don't carry bolt cutters.
Earl, it's Dolores again. There's a light on out at the old survey station.
The big gate. Not the little one beside it.
Earl, I drove out the survey track tonight. Just to see.
Chained, like you said. And it took me the longest time to find the highway again. It's one road, Earl.
Earl, is the old Roswell road open past the diner yet?
Earl, I'm down at the Mesa. She says tell you the coffee's fresh and the pie isn't.
Earl, there's a light sitting over the mesa east of town. It isn't a star. Stars don't sit that low.
It's watching the road.
Earl, those big dishes up at the observatory. Did they all turn at once tonight?
A little after two. All of them together, like sunflowers.
We interrupt this program. This is a local news bulletin.
Roswell, New Mexico. Tuesday, July eighth, nineteen forty-seven.
A flying disc is reported recovered on a ranch outside town. That is the wording on the notice.
There is no description of the object. The space for the name of the person reporting it is blank.
We have received the same line twice. We are reading it just as it came through.
Please stand by. We will return to our regular program.
